            <h2 id="h_01HNB3DHZDJEXNXZGE25E52611"><strong><span style="color: #2f3941;">Term of Service, Guidelines & Safety Requirements</span></strong></h2>
<p><span style="color: #2f3941;">To maintain compliance with the Community Guidelines, members are responsible for moderating their own Flickr content. More information about the safety requirements can be found </span><a href="https://www.flickrhelp.com/hc/en-us/articles/4404064374164-Set-the-Safety-Levels-of-Your-Flickr-Content-or-Account" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">here</a><span style="color: #2f3941;">.</span></p>
<ul>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.flickr.com/help/terms" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Flickr Terms.</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.flickr.com/help/guidelines/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Flickr Community Guidelines.</a></li>
</ul>
</ul>
<p> </p>
<h2 id="h_01HNB3DHZEFYDF2EDB26PQMNA8"><strong><span style="color: #2f3941;">Prohibited Content</span></strong></h2>
<p><span style="color: #2f3941;">We strive to make Flickr the safest community for photography enthusiasts. Our goal is to maintain an environment where Flickr users can create meaningful and safe experiences.</span></p>
<p><span style="color: #2f3941;">In order to do this, we’ve compiled a list of all things prohibited on our platform. Below you can find subjects we have a zero-tolerance policy for: </span></p>
<ul>
<li><span style="color: #2f3941;">Videos containing full frontal nudity or sexually explicit conduct.</span></li>
<li><span style="color: #2f3941;">Bestiality or promotion of bestiality.</span></li>
<li><span style="color: #2f3941;">Blackmail.</span></li>
<li><span style="color: #2f3941;">Child abuse.</span></li>
<li><span style="color: #2f3941;"><a href="https://www.flickrhelp.com/hc/en-us/articles/4419502786580-Combatting-child-sexual-abuse-material" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Child sexual abuse and exploitation.</a></span></li>
<li><span style="color: #2f3941;">Drugs.</span></li>
<li><span style="color: #2f3941;">Exposure (Non-consensual intimate images), including AI-generated imagery.</span></li>
<li><span style="color: #2f3941;">Hate speech.</span></li>
<li><span style="color: #2f3941;">Sexual violence or promotion of sexual violation (rape, sexual assault, molestation).</span></li>
<li><span style="color: #2f3941;">Incest or promotion of incest.</span></li>
<li><span style="color: #2f3941;">Impersonation.</span></li>
<li><span style="color: #2f3941;">Nazi content.</span></li>
<li><span style="color: #2f3941;">Necrophilia.</span></li>
<li><span style="color: #2f3941;">Personally identifiable information (IDs, passports, addresses, etc).</span></li>
<li><span style="color: #2f3941;">Urolagnia or coprophilia.</span></li>
<li><span style="color: #2f3941;">Screenshots of private conversations.</span></li>
<li><span style="color: #2f3941;">Screenshots of webcam footage.</span></li>
<li><span style="color: #2f3941;">Sectarianism.</span></li>
<li><span style="color: #2f3941;">Commercial sexual services, such as prostitution and escort services.;</span></li>
<li>
<span style="color: #2f3941;">Sextortion:</span>
<ul>
<li><span style="color: #2f3941;">Threatening or stating an intent to share intimate imagery with or without consent.</span></li>
<li><span style="color: #2f3941;">Solicitation of demands, bribes, or blackmail for sexual content and services.</span></li>
<li><span style="color: #2f3941;">Exposure or requests for exposure of sexual content.</span></li>
<li><span style="color: #2f3941;">Soliciting intimate imagery to share without consent.</span></li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><span style="color: #2f3941;">Spam.</span></li>
<li><span style="color: #2f3941;">Terrorism.</span></li>
<li><span style="color: #2f3941;">Tribute imagery: Any image depicting someone’s likeness being used as part of sexual gratification or in association with sexual fluids.</span></li>
<li><span style="color: #2f3941;">Voyeurism: Any image taken of someone without their knowledge or consent for the purpose of sexualization. Also known as creepshots, or upskirt.</span></li>
<li><span style="color: #2f3941;">Public masturbation or non-consensual public exhibitionism.</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span style="color: #2f3941;">If any of the content mentioned above is found on your account, your account will be terminated and we will not be providing any content that was previously uploaded. </span><span style="color: #2f3941;"></span></p>
<h3 id="h_01HWZZ5GWRVBQ0FPC0NDH1FD56"> </h3>
<h2 id="h_01HWZZ52KZWYCQN9AT430F0G05"><strong><span style="color: #2f3941;">Child Nudity Policy</span></strong></h2>
<p>Child nudity posted with a privacy setting of Public is not permitted on Flickr. Wholesome content featuring the unclothed pubic or buttocks area is allowed provided it is not sexualizing or exploitative in any way, and must be posted with privacy settings of Friends & Family or Private only.</p>
<p><span style="color: #2f3941;">Flickr has a zero tolerance policy regarding harmful content involving minors, regardless of privacy or safety settings. We aggressively remove and report sexually suggestive, abusive, or exploitative content involving minors. More information can be found <a href="https://www.flickrhelp.com/hc/en-us/articles/4419502786580-Combatting-child-sexual-abuse-material" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">here</a>.</span></p>
<h3 id="h_01HWZZ5TJEEP3VFKMCN3KBPMGG"> </h3>
<h2 id="h_01HNB3DHZEF1JXC4M36RCCTZ4C"><strong><span style="color: #2f3941;">Age Requirements</span></strong></h2>
<p><span style="color: #2f3941;">If you're under the age of 18 you cannot:</span></p>
<ul>
<li><span style="color: #2f3941;">Make your profile public in Flickr</span></li>
<li><span style="color: #2f3941;">View restricted or moderate content</span></li>
<li><span style="color: #2f3941;">Join 18+ groups</span></li>
</ul>
<p>If you're under the age of 16 you cannot:</p>
<ul>
<li><span style="color: #2f3941;">Create a Flickr account</span></li>
<li><span style="color: #2f3941;">Purchase premium services</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span style="color: #2f3941;">You can still browse and view images on Flickr without creating an account. However, depending on your location and local Terms (updated), </span><a href="https://www.flickrhelp.com/hc/en-us/articles/4404064206996-Content-filters" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">content filters</a><span style="color: #2f3941;"> may prevent you from accessing some photos or groups.</span></p>
<p><span style="color: #2f3941;"><br>Staying within the letter and spirit of these Terms & Guidelines is the best way to maintain a safe and enjoyable experience for you and other members of the Flickr community.</span></p>

        <article class="lt-article lt-mb-6" data-article="" itemscope="" itemtype="http://schema.org/Article">
          <header>
            <h1 class="lt-article__title lt-mb-4" itemprop="name">
              
              Set the Content Type for your Flickr uploads
            </h1>

            <div class="lt-d-sm-flex lt-justify-content-between lt-mb-4 lt-align-items-start">
              <div class="lt-mb-2 lt-me-sm-4">
                <div class="lt-entry-info ">
                  
                  <div class="lt-entry-info__content">
                    
                    <div class="lt-meta">
                      
                        Updated <time datetime="2024-07-05T15:25:53Z" title="07/05/2024, 10:25" data-datetime="relative">10 months ago</time>
                      
                    </div>
                    
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div class="lt-article-subscribe lt-d-flex lt-d-print-none lt-align-items-center">
                
                

                
              </div>
            </div>
          </header>

          <div class="lt-article__body rte " itemprop="articleBody">
            <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Flickr offers four different content type categories. Putting your content into the correct category is important as it ensures members view their preferred type of content.</span></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">When you upload content to Flickr, you need to assign each item to a category.</span></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The </span><strong>content type </strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">categories are as follows:</span></p>
<ul>
<li aria-level="1"><span>Photos/ Videos</span></li>
<li aria-level="1"><span>Screenshots/ Screencasts</span></li>
<li aria-level="1"><span>Illustration/ Art/ Animation/ CGI or other non-photographic images*</span></li>
<li aria-level="1"><span>Virtual Photography/ Machinima</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Regardless of content type, it is against Flickr guidelines to upload content where you do not own the copyright. For more information on copyright guidelines see this </span><a href="https://www.flickrhelp.com/hc/en-us/articles/4404063895956"><span style="font-weight: 400;">article</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">. </span></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><span>*We encourage members to select “</span><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Art/Illustration</strong><span>” as the content type for any AI-generated images. This helps members who prefer not to encounter this type of content to easily find and filter it out during their searches.</span></span></p>
<h2 id="h_01HBRRW4F5MFYG4J7EQFYHK5ME">Set your default content type<strong><br></strong>
</h2>
<ol>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1">
<span style="font-weight: 400;">Log into your account on a web browser and head to your </span><a href="https://www.flickr.com/account"><span style="font-weight: 400;">account settings</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">.</span>
</li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1">
<span style="font-weight: 400;">Click on the </span><strong>Privacy & Permissions </strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">tab.</span>
</li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1">
<span style="font-weight: 400;">Scroll down to </span><strong>Defaults for new uploads</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> </span>
</li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1">
<span style="font-weight: 400;">Click </span><strong>Edit</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> next to the </span><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">“What Safety Level and Content Type will your Photostream have” </span></em><span style="font-weight: 400;">setting.</span>
</li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1">
<span style="font-weight: 400;">Scroll down to </span><strong>What type of images do you normally upload? </strong>
</li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1">
<span style="font-weight: 400;">Select your content type | Click </span><strong>SAVE CHANGES</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">.</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"></span>
</li>
</ol>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><img src="/hc/article_attachments/9274276288404" alt="Screen_Shot_2022-09-12_at_1.12.18_PM.png" width="330" height="139"></span></p>
<h2 id="h_01HBRRWA2MHDBFFSZD8472VHZQ">Change the content type for a single item<span style="font-weight: 400;"></span>
</h2>
<ol>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Log into your account on a web browser | click on the photo page.</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1">
<span style="font-weight: 400;">Scroll down to the</span><strong> Additional Info </strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">section.</span>
</li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1">
<span style="font-weight: 400;">Next to </span><strong>Set Content Type</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> select the type you would like the item to have.</span>
</li>
</ol>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><img src="/hc/article_attachments/9274371632532" alt="Screen_Shot_2022-09-12_at_1.14.23_PM.png" width="323" height="195"></span></p>
<h2 id="h_01HBRRWJSF63DZ5TVYJ99SGX1M">Change the content type for multiple items<span style="font-weight: 400;"></span>
</h2>
<ol>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Log into your account on a web browser.</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1">
<span style="font-weight: 400;">Hover over </span><strong>You</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> | click </span><strong>Organize.</strong>
</li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Drag the items you are wishing to edit into the batch area.</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1">
<span style="font-weight: 400;">Click </span><strong>Permissions</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">.</span>
</li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1">
<span style="font-weight: 400;">Click </span><strong>Set content type</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">.</span>
</li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Select the setting you wish to apply.</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1">
<span style="font-weight: 400;">Click</span><strong> CHANGE CONTENT TYPE</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">.</span>
</li>
</ol>

                    <summary class="accordion__summary accordion__summary--no-icon h4 lt-py-4 lt-mb-0" role="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="PromotedArticle-13690320471060">
                      <span class="accordion__summary-wrapper">
                        Free account limit changes and enforcement
                        <svg class="lt-icon" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="2" stroke="currentColor">
                          <use xlink:href="#icon-chevron-down"></use>

                      </span>
                    </summary>
                    <div class="accordion__content lt-article__body rte " id="PromotedArticle-13690320471060"><h2 id="h_01J9KPBBTFY3KJTHR9066ZNDSH"><span style="color: #434343;">What are the limits for free accounts? </span></h2>
<p><span style="background-color: #ffffff;">Effective May 1, 2022 free accounts are subject to the following limitations: </span></p><ul>
<li>
<strong>Only Safe (public or non-public) content allowed. </strong>Moderate or Restricted photos or videos cannot be uploaded to a free account. </li>
<li>
<strong>Maximum of 50 non-public photos or videos. </strong>N​on-public consists of Private & Friends and Family photos.</li>
<li><strong>1,000 item upload limit.</strong></li>
</ul><p>Content on free accounts that exceeds the limits listed above is at risk of deletion.</p><p><span style="font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;">For more information, check out our </span><a style="background-color: #ffffff; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;" href="https://blog.flickr.net/en/2022/03/17/flickr-forever-2022/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">blog</a><span style="font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;"> or </span><a style="background-color: #ffffff; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;" href="https://flickr.com/account/upgrade/pro?utm_campaign=flickrhelp&utm_content=free_limit_change&utm_source=help_article" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">upgrade to Pro</a><span style="font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;"> now for unlimited storage, ad-free browsing, and advanced stats.</span></p>
<h2 id="h_01J9KPBBTFEQ05PTFH3HB88CNA">Why did we make changes to free accounts? </h2>
<p><span style="color: #212124; background-color: #ffffff;">We announced the limits for free accounts on Flickr to support our mission to create </span><a href="https://blog.flickr.net/en/2022/03/17/flickr-forever-2022/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">the safest, most inclusive global community for photography enthusiasts</a><span style="color: #212124; background-color: #ffffff;">.</span></p>
<p><span style="color: #212124; background-color: #ffffff;">Non-public photos cannot be enjoyed by the broader Flickr community to be inspired by, connect around, and shared widely. </span></p>
<p><span style="color: #212124; background-color: #ffffff;">We understand some may not want their photography to be shared with anyone & that many people’s photo collections are personal to them. We want them to have a home on Flickr as well, so we are asking those who are not actively contributing to the community of photographers on Flickr, simply to pay for the storage we have previously allocated to them for free. </span></p>
<h2 id="h_01J9KPBBTF0DESJ6DX43AWF1PN">How can I bring my account back into compliance with new limits?<span style="color: #2f3941;"><br></span>
</h2>
<p>If you’d like to continue posting non-Safe content or more than 50 non-public photos on your account (and more than a 1,000 posts total), please <a href="https://flickr.com/account/upgrade/pro" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">upgrade to Pro</a>.</p>
<p><span class="wysiwyg-underline">Note</span>: If your account has been suspended for posting non-Safe content, it will be automatically reactivated when you upgrade.</p>
<p>As an alternative, please see the following instructions:</p>
<ul>
<li>
<strong>If you have more than 50 non-public photos on your account, </strong><a href="https://www.flickrhelp.com/hc/en-us/articles/4404078163732-Change-your-privacy-settings" target="_blank" rel="noopener">here’s how to change your privacy settings.</a><span style="color: #2f3941;"> </span>
</li>
<li>
<strong style="font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;">If you have ANY moderate or restricted photos on your account</strong>, <a href="https://www.flickrhelp.com/hc/en-us/articles/4404079675156-Downloading-content-from-Flickr" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">here’s how to download them</a> so you can safely store them elsewhere. From there, you can<a href="https://www.flickrhelp.com/hc/en-us/articles/4404058338708-How-to-delete-photos-or-videos" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"> delete</a> the content from your Flickr account. You must delete all non-Safe content from your account, <strong>regardless of Privacy setting.</strong> Once all non-Safe content has been deleted you may<a href="https://www.flickrhelp.com/hc/en-us/requests/new?tf_360045441472=trust___safety&tf_1900000078047=account_review" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"> contact our Trust & Safety team here</a> so that your account can be reviewed and reactivated.</li>
</ul>
<p><a href="https://www.flickrhelp.com/hc/en-us/articles/9099749005716-How-to-locate-non-public-and-or-moderate-or-restricted-content-on-your-Flickr-account" target="_blank" rel="noopener">How to locate non-public and/or moderate or restricted content on your Flickr account</a></p>
<p><span class="wysiwyg-underline">Note</span><span style="color: #2f3941;">: Incorrectly setting moderate or restricted content as safe is against our <a href="https://www.flickr.com/help/terms" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Terms of Service</a> and <a href="https://www.flickr.com/help/guidelines" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Community Guidelines</a>. </span></p>
<h2 id="h_01J9KPBBTFYXCD121J96DXQ8PT">How do I make bulk changes to my content?</h2>
<p><strong>Change Privacy Levels in Bulk</strong></p>
<ol>
<li>
<span style="color: #2f3941;">Hover over </span><strong><span style="color: #2f3941;">You</span></strong><span style="color: #2f3941;"> | select </span><strong><span style="color: #2f3941;">Organize</span></strong><span style="color: #2f3941;">.</span>
</li>
<li><span style="color: #2f3941;">Drag and drop content to the batch area.</span></li>
<li>
<span style="color: #2f3941;">Click </span><strong><span style="color: #2f3941;">Permissions</span></strong><span style="color: #2f3941;">, select </span><strong><span style="color: #2f3941;">Who can see, comment, tag?</span></strong>
</li>
<li><span style="color: #2f3941;">Select your preferred settings.</span></li>
<li>
<span style="color: #2f3941;">Click </span><strong><span style="color: #2f3941;">Change Permissions</span></strong><span style="color: #2f3941;">.</span>
</li>
</ol>
<p>For more information on changing privacy settings, see: <a href="https://www.flickrhelp.com/hc/en-us/articles/4404078163732-Change-your-privacy-settings" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Change your privacy settings</a><span style="color: #2f3941;"> <br></span><strong><br>Delete Photos or Videos in Bulk</strong></p>
<ol>
<li>Hover over <strong>You</strong><span> </span>| click<span> </span><strong>Organize.</strong>
</li>
<li>Drag and drop the content to the batch area or select all the content in an album.</li>
<li>
<span>Click </span><strong>Edit photos</strong><span> | click </span><strong>Delete</strong><span>.</span>
</li>
<li><span>You will then see the following warning | click <strong>Delete</strong>.</span></li>
<li><span>Click <strong>YES, GO AHEAD </strong>| click <strong>Confirm</strong>.</span></li>
</ol>
<p><span>For more information on deleting content, see: </span><a href="https://www.flickrhelp.com/hc/en-us/articles/4404058338708-How-to-delete-photos-or-videos" target="_blank" rel="noopener">How to delete photos or videos</a></p>
<h2 id="h_01J9KPBBTFZ7Z1DGNWTMCS8XXD">I got an email saying my account is out of compliance by mistake. </h2>
<p>If you’ve checked & your account appears to be in compliance, it’s possible you received an email due to outdated caching. <br><br>You may disregard the email-- or if you’d prefer to confirm that your account is in good standing, you can <a href="https://www.flickrhelp.com/hc/en-us/requests/new" target="_blank" rel="noopener">contact us</a>. </p>
<h2 id="h_01J9KPBBTFBA6YDX9A98T9FNTV">What happens if I do nothing?</h2>
<p>All content on free accounts that exceeds the limitations listed above will be deleted. This includes:</p>
<ul>
<li>Any non-public photos beyond the 50 non-public photo limit.</li>
<li>Any moderate or restricted content.</li>
<li>Any content over the 1,000 item limit. </li>
</ul>
<p>Additionally, you will be unable to upload additional content until the account is brought back within the limits.</p>
<h2 id="h_01J9KPBBTF8KW671ZVRAY878Z7">
<span style="color: #212124; background-color: #ffffff;">How do I upgrade to Pro?</span><span style="color: #212124; background-color: #ffffff;"><br></span>
</h2>
<p><span style="background-color: #ffffff;">To upload unlimited content, regardless of privacy settings & safety levels, </span><span style="color: #212124; background-color: #ffffff;">we recommend purchasing a </span><a href="https://flickr.com/account/upgrade/pro" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Pro subscription</a><span style="color: #212124; background-color: #ffffff;">. <br></span></p>
<p><span style="color: #212124; background-color: #ffffff;">For details of available options, check out our </span><a href="https://www.flickrhelp.com/hc/en-us/articles/4404064001812-Pricing-FAQ" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Pricing FAQ</a><span style="color: #2f3941; background-color: #ffffff;">. </span></p></div>

                        Delete Your Flickr Account

                    <div class="accordion__content lt-article__body rte " id="PromotedArticle-4404071373588"><p dir="ltr"><strong style="font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;">If you want to delete your account but are unable to log in to it, please <a href="#h_01FWEQ180V469A5AZPXW3AD002" target="_self">click here</a>.</strong></p>
<p> </p>
<p><span class="wysiwyg-underline"><strong>Note</strong></span><span style="font-weight: 400;">: </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">Once you delete your account, all of your photos and account content will be deleted, and we won't be able to recover them.</span></p>
<p> </p>
<h3 id="h_01HEK8X5CHW1VMWHP6FF84S8YV" dir="ltr">Delete your Flickr Account</h3>
<p dir="ltr"><strong>Web Browser</strong></p>
<ol>
<li>
<span style="font-weight: 400;">Sign in to</span><a href="https://flickr.com/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">Flickr</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> using a web browser.</span>
</li>
<li>Click on your <strong>profile photo</strong> | select <a href="https://www.flickr.com/account" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>Settings</strong></a>.</li>
<li>Under the “<strong>Accounts & Subscription</strong>” tab, click <strong>Delete your Flickr account </strong>under "Account". </li>
<li>Read the important messages, then click <strong style="font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;">OK-NEXT</strong><span style="font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;">.</span>
</li>
<li><span style="font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;">You'll be prompted to enter your password to confirm your account deletion.</span></li>
<li><span style="font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;">Check <strong>Yes, I fully understand...</strong></span></li>
<li><span style="font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Click DELETE MY ACCOUNT.</strong></span></li>
</ol>
<p><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Android + iOS</strong></p>
<ol class="p-rich_text_list p-rich_text_list__bullet" data-stringify-type="unordered-list" data-indent="0" data-border="0">
<li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Log into your Flickr account on the Flickr app. </li>
<li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Tap the <strong>three dot menu</strong> on the top-right corner.</li>
<li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Scroll down and tap on <strong>Delete account.</strong>
</li>
<li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Read the important messages, then click<span> </span><strong data-stringify-type="bold">OK-NEXT</strong>.</li>
<li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">You’ll be prompted to enter your password to confirm your account deletion.</li>
<li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Check<span> </span><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Yes, I fully understand...</strong>
</li>
<li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Click<strong data-stringify-type="bold"> DELETE MY ACCOUNT.</strong>
</li>
</ol>
<p dir="ltr"><span class="wysiwyg-underline"><strong>Note</strong></span><strong>: </strong>Public images from deleted accounts may still appear in third-party search engines, like Google. <a href="https://www.flickrhelp.com/hc/en-us/articles/4404078147860-Search-engines-index" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Learn more about search engine indexes.</a> </p>
<h2 id="h_01FWEQ180V469A5AZPXW3AD002" dir="ltr">Can't log in to your Flickr account?</h2>
<p>If you are unable to log in to your Flickr account in order to delete it, please follow our guide below to go through our account verification process.</p>
<p> </p>
<pre><iframe id="ston-N2sgUCTPTT" src="https://stonly.com/embed/en/N2sgUCTPTT/view/" name="StonlyExplanation" width="100%" height="815" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen="allowfullscreen"> </iframe></pre></div>

                        <svg class="lt-icon" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="2" stroke="currentColor">

                    <div class="accordion__content lt-article__body rte " id="PromotedArticle-4404078626964"><p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">We’re working towards an option that allows members to update their email address from the account settings.</p>
<p>For now, you can do so by contacting our Support team using the guide below. </p>
<p> </p>
<p><iframe id="ston-AcE46Jcftx" src="https://stonly.com/embed/en/AcE46Jcftx/view/" name="StonlyExplanation" width="100%" height="815" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen="allowfullscreen"> </iframe></p></div>

                <details-accordion>

                    <summary class="accordion__summary accordion__summary--no-icon h4 lt-py-4 lt-mb-0" role="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="PromotedArticle-6184781339924">
                      <span class="accordion__summary-wrapper">
                        Account has been reviewed by Flickr staff and marked as suspended
                        <svg class="lt-icon" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="2" stroke="currentColor">
                          <use xlink:href="#icon-chevron-down"></use>
                        </svg>
                      </span>
                    </summary>
                    <div class="accordion__content lt-article__body rte " id="PromotedArticle-6184781339924"><p><span style="color: #2f3941; background-color: #ffffff;">If your account is determined to contain posts that violate our </span><a href="https://www.flickr.com/help/terms"><span style="color: #1155cc; background-color: #ffffff;">Terms & Conditions of Use</span></a><span style="color: #2f3941; background-color: #ffffff;"> or </span><a href="https://www.flickr.com/help/guidelines"><span style="color: #1155cc; background-color: #ffffff;">Community Guidelines</span></a><span style="color: #2f3941; background-color: #ffffff;">, </span><strong><span style="color: #2f3941; background-color: #ffffff;">your account</span></strong><span style="color: #2f3941; background-color: #ffffff;"> </span><strong><span style="color: #2f3941; background-color: #ffffff;">may be temporarily placed into a suspended state.</span></strong><span style="color: #2f3941; background-color: #ffffff;"> In that case, you will receive a notification with more details from Flickr’s Trust & Safety team in your email and FlickrMail account.</span></p>
<h2 id="h_01HY0X8RVWGV2GX8TGAF04X62A"><span style="color: #2f3941;">What happens to my account when it is suspended?</span></h2>
<ul>
<li>
<span style="color: #2f3941; background-color: #ffffff;">Your content will be viewable </span><em><span style="color: #2f3941; background-color: #ffffff;">only to you</span></em><span style="color: #2f3941; background-color: #ffffff;"> as the logged-in account owner. Other members will not be able to see your photos. While your profile will still be searchable, your photos will be hidden from public view.</span>
</li>
<li><span style="color: #2f3941; background-color: #ffffff;">Your comments will not be displayed.</span></li>
<li><span style="color: #2f3941; background-color: #ffffff;">You will not be able to add new photos to groups. Group admins will not be able to see your photo submission.</span></li>
<li><span style="color: #2f3941; background-color: #ffffff;">You will still be able to upload Safe content, comment, fave, and send or receive FlickrMail.</span></li>
<li><span style="color: #2f3941; background-color: #ffffff;">Any existing group photos will be hidden from public view.</span></li>
<li><span style="color: #2f3941; background-color: #ffffff;">Other members will not receive notifications of your activity.</span></li>
</ul>
<h2 id="h_01HY0X8RVXBXZC7BCJQ7RVERYA"><span style="color: #434343;">How do I remove the suspended state from my account?</span></h2>
<h3 id="h_01JMEN9GE4CKD6CCHHC6HCKKAY"><span style="color: #2f3941;">Non-Safe content in a Free account</span></h3>
<p><span style="color: #2f3941;">To restore your account, please</span><a href="https://www.flickr.com/account/upgrade/pro"> Upgrade to Pro</a><span style="color: #2f3941;"> and make sure your content is properly moderated. Your account will be automatically reactivated.</span></p>
<p><span style="background-color: #ffffff;">As an alternative, you must delete all non-Safe content from your account, regardless of Privacy setting. </span>Once all non-Safe content has been deleted you may <a href="https://www.flickrhelp.com/hc/en-us/requests/new?tf_360045441472=trust___safety&tf_1900000078047=account_review"><strong>contact our Trust & Safety team here</strong></a><strong> so that your account can be reviewed and reactivated</strong></p>
<h3 id="h_01JMEN9KMTBTF34QHMDY36J93Q"><span style="background-color: #ffffff;">Commercial activity in a Free account</span></h3>
<p><span style="background-color: #ffffff;">To restore your account, </span><strong>please <a href="https://www.flickr.com/account/upgrade/pro">Upgrade to Pro</a></strong><span style="background-color: #ffffff;">. Your account will be automatically reactivated.</span></p>
<p><span style="background-color: #ffffff;">As an alternative, you must delete all commercial content from your account. </span>Once all commercial content has been deleted you may <a href="https://www.flickrhelp.com/hc/en-us/requests/new?tf_360045441472=trust___safety&tf_1900000078047=account_review"><strong>contact our Trust & Safety team here</strong></a><span style="color: #1155cc;"></span><strong> so that your account can be reviewed and reactivated.</strong></p>
<h3 id="h_01JMEN9ZWWM3V9XHR4WVW9P3HJ"><span style="color: #2f3941;">For all other violations</span></h3>
<p><span style="color: #2f3941;">You will need to remedy the issues described in the notification from the Trust & Safety team.</span></p>
<p><span style="color: #2f3941;">Once you have brought your account into compliance, you can contact our Trust & Safety team </span><a href="https://www.flickrhelp.com/hc/en-us/requests/new?tf_360045441472=trust___safety&tf_1900000078047=account_review"><span style="color: #1f73b7;">here</span></a><span style="background-color: #ffffff;">. </span></p>
<h2 id="h_01HY0X8RVXS1686D90J0EG71V2"><span style="color: #434343;">How do I learn more about why my account was suspended?</span></h2>
<p><span style="color: #2f3941; background-color: #ffffff;">For more information about policies that may result in accounts being placed in a suspended state, please refer to the following articles in our Help Center:</span></p>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.flickrhelp.com/hc/en-us/articles/20529310987796-The-rules-of-Flickr">The Rules of Flickr</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.flickrhelp.com/hc/en-us/articles/4404064374164-Set-the-Safety-Levels-of-Your-Flickr-Content-or-Account">Set the Safety Levels of Your Flickr Content or Account</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.flickrhelp.com/hc/en-us/articles/4404057965332-Flickr-commercial-use-policy">Flickr commercial Use Policy</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.flickrhelp.com/hc/en-us/articles/21344081310100-Types-of-enforcement-actions-taken-by-the-Trust-Safety-team">Types of enforcement actions taken by the Trust & Safety team</a></li>
</ul></div>

        <article class="lt-article lt-mb-6" data-article="" itemscope="" itemtype="http://schema.org/Article">
          <header>
            <h1 class="lt-article__title lt-mb-4" itemprop="name">
              
              Content filters
            </h1>

            <div class="lt-d-sm-flex lt-justify-content-between lt-mb-4 lt-align-items-start">
              <div class="lt-mb-2 lt-me-sm-4">
                <div class="lt-entry-info ">
                  
                  <div class="lt-entry-info__content">
                    
                    <div class="lt-meta">
                      
                        Updated <time datetime="2024-01-30T16:43:59Z" title="01/30/2024, 10:43" data-datetime="relative">1 year ago</time>
                      
                    </div>
                    
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div class="lt-article-subscribe lt-d-flex lt-d-print-none lt-align-items-center">
                
                

                
              </div>
            </div>
          </header>

          <div class="lt-article__body rte " itemprop="articleBody">
            <p id="h_01HNB6185AS49MK6H5QK59RQK9"><span style="color: #2f3941; background-color: #ffffff;">Let others know more about your images by using Safety Levels and Content Type.</span></p>
<p><span style="color: #2f3941; background-color: #ffffff;">Flickr is a global community made up of many different kinds of people. What's OK in your backyard may not be OK in someone else’s. Each one of us bears the responsibility of categorizing our own content within this landscape. </span></p>
<p><span style="color: #2f3941; background-color: #ffffff;">We've introduced some filters to help everyone try to get along. In order for these filters to work, we're relying on </span><strong><em><span style="color: #2f3941; background-color: #ffffff;">you</span></em></strong><span style="color: #2f3941; background-color: #ffffff;"> to filter your content appropriately.</span></p>
<p><span style="color: #2f3941; background-color: #ffffff;">There are 2 types of filters that you need to use for your content:</span></p>
<ul>
<li>
<span style="color: #2f3941; background-color: #ffffff;"></span><span style="color: #2f3941; background-color: #ffffff;">Safety Level.</span>
</li>
<li><span style="color: #2f3941; background-color: #ffffff;">Content Type.</span></li>
</ul>
<h2 id="h_01HNB6185A20QFGC51C3SCPD1E"><span style="color: #2f3941; background-color: #ffffff;">Safety Levels</span></h2>
<p id="h_01HNB65HYCGNV33QEJG7E993WR"><span class="wysiwyg-color-black50"><strong><em><span class="wysiwyg-underline">Note</span></em></strong><em>: Free accounts are limited to posting Safe content only. Members interested in uploading Moderate or Restricted content will need to </em><a href="https://www.flickr.com/account/upgrade/pro" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">upgrade to Pro</a><em>.</em></span></p>
<p><span style="color: #2f3941;">The following is a general guide to Safety Levels: </span><span style="color: #434343;"></span><span style="color: #2f3941;"></span></p>
<figure style="height: 70px; width: 100%;" class="wysiwyg-table"><table style="border-collapse: collapse; border: 1px solid #2F3941;" class="ck-table-resized wysiwyg-table-resized">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 51.54%;">
<col style="width: 48.46%;">
</colgroup>
<tbody>
<tr style="height: 26px;">
<td style="border: 1px solid #2F3941; height: 26px; width: 34.7143%;">
<h3 class="wysiwyg-indent0.8333333333333334" id="h_01HNB16XQYFB6DNGNJRY7MR09M"><strong>Safe</strong></h3>Content that is generally acceptable to a global, public audience.</td>
<td style="border: 1px solid #2F3941; width: 32.5714%;">
<br>Think of content that is appropriate for public viewing in any setting. Content marked as safe should not include any explicit or suggested mature content (sexual, violent, graphic, etc). <br><br><strong><span class="wysiwyg-underline">Note</span></strong>: Content that qualifies as Safe should not contain links to adult websites, have sexually explicit tags or descriptions, or be included in sexually explicit groups. In addition, medically graphic content, such as imagery showing open wounds, graphic surgical procedures, or other intense medical situations, should not be posted as Safe.</td>
</tr>
<tr style="height: 22px;">
<td style="border: 1px solid #2F3941; height: 22px; width: 34.7143%;">
<h3 id="h_01HNB0Q59JFDTHNBJ46YN4R3F3"><span style="color: #434343;"><strong>Moderate</strong></span></h3>
<p><span style="color: #434343;">Content that may be unacceptable to some audiences.</span></p>
<p> </p>
</td>
<td style="border: 1px solid #2F3941; width: 32.5714%;">Think of content that is appropriate for mature audiences, but not graphic or explicit. This can include partial nudity (bare breasts and bottoms) or sexually suggestive content.</td>
</tr>
<tr style="height: 22px;">
<td style="border: 1px solid #2F3941; height: 22px; width: 34.7143%;">
<h3 id="h_01HNB0Q59JJ5TEQ3QX1JX3QSHM"><span style="color: #434343;"><strong>Restricted</strong></span></h3>
<span style="color: #434343;">Content that must be restricted to limited audiences only.</span>
</td>
<td style="border: 1px solid #2F3941; width: 32.5714%;">
<p>Think of content that is only appropriate for mature audiences because of its graphic or explicit nature. This includes full-frontal nudity (genitalia), sexual acts (including simulated sexual acts), gore & graphic violence, and other adult themes.</p>
<p><strong><span class="wysiwyg-underline">Note</span>: </strong>Videos uploaded to Flickr cannot contain Restricted<strong> </strong>content. Only photos may include Restricted content.</p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table></figure><p> </p>
<p class="p1">Images using pixelation, blurring, shapes, or other methods to censoring mature content should still be moderated according to the underlying imagery.</p>
<p class="p1">We understand that selecting the right safety level can be tricky, especially when it comes to nudity and sexual content. For more details, please review our <a href="https://www.flickrhelp.com/hc/en-us/articles/23250290741908" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Guide to Safety Levels for Nudity & Sexual Content</a>.</p>
<p class="p1"><strong><span class="wysiwyg-underline" style="color: #2f3941;">Note</span></strong><span style="color: #2f3941;">: If your login ID is based in Singapore, Hong Kong, India, Taiwan or with Maktoob.com you will only be able to view safe content based on your local Terms of Service (this means you won’t be able to turn SafeSearch off). If your login ID is based in Germany or Romania you are not able to view restricted content due to your local Terms of Service.</span></p>
<p class="p1"><span style="color: #2f3941;">Bear in mind that all content you upload is subject to the </span><a href="http://flickr.com/terms.gne" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Terms of Service</a><span style="color: #2f3941;"> and our </span><a href="http://flickr.com/guidelines.gne" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Community Guidelines</a><span style="color: #2f3941;">.</span></p>
<h2 id="h_01HNB65HYD9TBDHCGR0KS8X617"><span style="color: #2f3941;">Content Type</span></h2>
<ul>
<li><span style="color: #2f3941;">Photos/ Videos;</span></li>
<li><span style="color: #2f3941;">Screenshots/ Screencasts;</span></li>
<li><span style="color: #2f3941;">Illustration/ Art/ Animation/ CGI or other non-photographic images*;</span></li>
<li><span style="color: #2f3941;">Virtual Photography/ Machinima.</span></li>
</ul>
<p><em><span style="color: #2f3941;">*We encourage members to select “Art/Illustration” as the content type for any AI-generated images. This helps members who prefer not to encounter this type of content to easily find and filter it out during their searches.</span></em></p>
<p><span style="color: #2f3941;">When you upload content to Flickr, you need to select the best fit from these 4 categories. </span></p>
<p><span style="color: #2f3941;">Putting your content into these categories means that everyone can then apply filters to searches to make sure they're seeing their preferred content.</span><strong><span style="color: #2f3941; background-color: #ffffff;"> </span></strong></p>
<h2 id="h_01HNDM04FRG3359X1T1FMW77RP"><span style="color: #2f3941;">Links to Get Started</span></h2>
<ul>
<li>
<a href="http://flickr.com/account/prefs/filters/?from=privacy" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Set your Safety Level & Content Type defaults</a><span style="color: #1f73b7;">.</span>
</li>
<li>
<a href="http://flickr.com/account/prefs/safesearch/?from=privacy" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Set your SafeSearch preference</a><span style="color: #1f73b7;">.</span>
</li>
<li>
<a href="http://flickr.com/account/prefs/optout/?from=privacy" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Opt out of having your photos turn up in searches</a><span style="color: #1f73b7;">.</span>
</li>
</ul>
          </div>
